verdict.rationale: Internal comment threads and @mentions on emails are a fair capability for an email client, so this axis applies. However, nothing in the pack documents team comments, side-threads, @mentions or shared discussion on messages. The evidence covers labels, AI chat with threads, composing, a unified inbox and self-hosting, none of which is internal team discussion.

support.subject: As a team-lead, we can discuss an email in an internal side-thread — comments and @mentions beside the message — instead of forwarding copies around
